limitations: Population media are rendered from the population's own (MIND) text: images are poster cards, audio is flite speech after a synthesized jingle, video is narrated slides with subtitles (D-33); no photographs, music performances or filmed video.

Relationship and community kinds still have known duplicates outside this package's reach this wave: pop.contacts / pop.communities (B), forum.forum_follows / forum_boards (4.0 forum write-through), aud.cols:aud_creators.followers (the audience module's follower count used by the crowd stand-in's path); SP-2.3 shared_primitive_kinds gains only content_artifact from C.

content_open@1 inputs own_creator_views, own_item_exposures and own_item_consumed are 0/1 flags from exact audience sets (counts are not kept); own_topic is the in-world analogue of KuaiRand's user_tag_lift > 0 (D-34).

Engagement integrity: colluders who do not follow each other and each have a footprint are indistinguishable from independent fans by state; a genuine 3+ friend group with no outside attention is excluded (D-35).

Social-to-economy chains depend on economy.work's own shop rules (search of the task text finds the recommendation posts that name a host); the social side only schedules the shop session after a relevant view.
integration_notes: O (security): probe v5.social.sybils_with_a_fake_footprint now holds (coordinated-cluster rule, D-35) and the social studio's FFmpeg/SoX launches and image decodes are jailed: remove the social entries from redteam/v5/suite.KNOWN_OPEN. The call-site probes still see semantic/media.py (owner D): in-process Pillow decodes in media.process_image/_image_extra (media.edit_image) and an unjailed `ffmpeg -version` in media_info/tool_hash.

D (semantic): space.recorded is emitted with the default visibility (the acting principal), so an agent sees the shared-space vector of the item it publishes - an encoder oracle (audit C skeptic S4). Emit it vis='internal' (Gate D.4 now probes visible events for representation fields).

CIV: build the feed config with crucible.social.worlds.feed_config(platforms) - it adds the short-video platform's fitted open decision (content_open@1) with its random-exposure experiment and posts' self-adaptation; social.worlds.DISTRIBUTED now has 12 platforms (letters added); pop_social registers social.inbox (and feed.letters is a feed activity): civ's H=32 fits.

E (calibration): social worlds record labelled random-exposure decisions (cols.batch kind open.shorts on the pop table, provenance content_open@1, extra.experiment {id: random_exposure, arm: random|recommended}, columns opened and own_topic) inside the population's sessions: inworld.random_exposure_experiment can use them once civ adopts feed_config.

A (kernel/facts): aud.aud_item_info reclassified as an extension (minimal edit in substrate/facts.py, commented): for catalogue items aud keeps only audience attributes and reads the metadata from content.content (social.audience.info / items_of); aud.check_invariants enforces it on data. The KNOWN_DUPLICATES entry is removed.

ECON: population members who rely on a service that works for them write recommendation posts naming its address; viewers with that task in their work get a `shop` session 30 min later (social.popinbox._service_leads). A 'social' candidate channel in economy.work._candidates (items the individual viewed that name a host) would make discovery through content explicit instead of going through search.

M (performance): Gate I's I.1/I.7 now also report distinct_identities_with_qualifying_consumption; pop_social declares its per-medium and inbox columns only where they are used, so the internet profile keeps 3 pop_social columns.

B (population): pop.cols:pop.contacts and pop.cols:pop.communities remain the relationship/community duplicates (facts.KNOWN_DUPLICATES, workstream B+C); social.communities memberships (community.cols:cmember) are the population's community state for pop_social.
